Subject: Scheduling a 60–90m ML/Infra lab — proposed slots & agenda

Hi Jenny — great conversation earlier today, thanks for the context on your inference requirements. As discussed, the next best step is a focused ML/Infra lab (60–90 minutes) where our infra and ML engs can:

- Walk through a representative workload (latency, throughput, batch patterns)
- Review model variants and quantization tradeoffs for cost/latency
- Validate prefix/caching and KV-cache behavior with your sequence lengths
- Sketch an initial rollout/rollback policy and perf SLOs

Proposed slots (all PDT):
- Wed 11 Jun — 10:00–11:30
- Thu 12 Jun — 14:00–15:30
- Mon 16 Jun — 09:00–10:30

If you'd prefer a tighter 60-minute session (we can shorten demos and focus on your top 2 scenarios), we can do that as well — please indicate preference.

Prep items we need from your side: attendee list (engineers + product), a small sample of typical input shapes (JSON or CSV) and rough traffic profile (p50/p95 tokens per request, expected qps), and any compliance constraints (e.g., data residency, HIPAA).

Attached: redwood-tdx-preflight.pdf (short checklist). Connor and Monica will own the technical runthrough. If you confirm a slot, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda/collab doc.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Laura

We can absolutely run a 60-minute focused lab. Proposed flow for 60m:
- 5m quick intros & goals
- 15m workload profile + expected SLOs (you present)
- 20m targeted run: live perf against a representative request shape (p50/p95 measurements)
- 15m discussion: batching, caching, quantization recommendations and rollout plan

Action items for ArborHealth to enable the live run:
1) Share one or two sample request payloads (JSON) and a small test set (<=200 rows) — you mentioned you can deliver tomorrow
2) Provide a list of attendees and which engineers will have permission to view logs / shared sandbox (helps us enable the right access)

I uploaded a sample eval plan to the shared folder and attached sample-eval-plan.csv for your review. Also linking our short SOC2/HIPAA note in the agenda doc for Kevin.
